create_cpp_tokenizer: create a C++ source code tokenizer that yields Token objects for identifiers, constants, syntax, and preprocessor directives
test_GetTokens: test the GetTokens function to tokenize a C++ source string into a sequence of Token objects
build_token_class: build a Token object with token type, name, start index, and end index for representing C++ tokens
summarize_GetTokens: summarize how GetTokens parses C++ source code into tokens including strings, chars, numbers, and preprocessor directives
refactor_GetTokens: refactor the GetTokens function to handle additional C++0x string prefixes and numeric suffixes
